stage_days: with h as (select h.record_id, h.new_text as stage, h.changed_at, h.history_id from property_history h join deals d on d.pc_0012_id = h.record_id where h.object = 'deals' and h.property = 'stage' and d.pipeline = 'defense'), s as (select record_id, stage, changed_at, lead(changed_at) over (partition by record_id order by changed_at, history_id) as left_at from h) select stage, count(*) as visits, count(*) filter (where left_at is null) as now_in, round(avg(extract(epoch from (coalesce(left_at, now()) - changed_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) as avg_days, round(max(extract(epoch from (coalesce(left_at, now()) - changed_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) as max_days from s where stage is not null group by stage
closed: select d.pc_0012_id as id, d.name, d.stage, s.is_won, d.amount_base, d.created_at, (select max(h.changed_at) from property_history h where h.object = 'deals' and h.property = 'stage' and h.record_id = d.pc_0012_id and h.new_text = d.stage) as closed_at from deals d join property_options s on s.object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and s.property = 'stage' and s.api_value = d.stage where d.pipeline = 'defense' and s.is_closed order by closed_at desc nulls last limit 200
stages: select api_value, label, is_closed, is_won from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and property = 'stage' and record_status = 'active' and 'defense' = any(parent_values) order by display_order
base: select code from currencies where is_base
